title: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes…
description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl contain a code injection vulnerability. The module's update_self_from_url function rewrites its source by appending fetched list lines without validating their content. An attacker controlling the fetched list can inject arbitrary Perl code that executes in every process loading IO::Socket::SSL until the module is reinstalled.
